name: Eli
title: Head Grappling Coach
bio: Eli started grappling while wrestling in high school and was introduced to Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and MMA training his senior year. A black belt in BJJ, and a brown belt in Judo, Eli teaches gi and no-gi Jiu-Jitsu, along with Wrestling and Judo. He holds a decorated competitive record in Jiu-Jitsu, Judo, and Wrestling, as well as MMA. Eli has been coaching for over 10 years, and has trained athletes at all levels, from beginners to active UFC fighters.
excerpt: Eli is a world-class coach with extensive experience in professional combat sports.
metaDescription: Eli is Harbinger MMA's head grappling coach in Portland: BJJ black belt, judo brown belt and 10+ years coaching gi, no-gi, wrestling, judo and MMA.
